title: Beach Hideaway 30A
meta_description: Escape to Beach Hideaway 30A, a beautiful 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath Santa Rosa Beach vacation rental near Gulf Place on Scenic Highway 30A. Walk less than 300 yards to Spooky Lane Beach Access and the sugar-white sands of the Gulf of Mexico. Enjoy two community pools, hot tub, tennis court, sand volleyball, covered parking and two private balconies with peek-a-boo Gulf views.
description_expanded: AboutBeach Hideaway 30A | 30A Vacation Rental Near Gulf Place | Walk to Beach | 2 Pools, Hot Tub, Volleyball Court, Tennis Court | Ensuites Welcome to Beach Hideaway 30A, a beautiful 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath Santa Rosa Beach vacation rental near Gulf Place on Scenic Highway 30A. Ideally located in The Legends of Santa Rosa Beach, this coastal townhome puts you within walking distance of the sugar-white sand, Gulf Place shopping and dining, while offering two community pools, a hot tub, tennis courts, sand volleyball, covered parking and peek-a-boo Gulf views. Property Highlights • Prime Santa Rosa Beach location on Scenic Highway 30A near Gulf Place • Walk to Spooky Lane Beach Access – less than 300 yards away • 2 Bedrooms | 2.5 Bathrooms • King primary suite with private balcony and peek-a-boo Gulf views • Guest bedroom with two full beds and private bathroom • Queen sleeper sofa in the living room • Two community swimming pools • Community hot tub • Tennis court and sand volleyball court • Fully stocked kitchen with spices included • Quartz countertops and updated appliances • Open-concept kitchen, dining and living area • Two private balconies • 4 backpack beach chairs, beach umbrella and beach wagon • High chair, pack 'n play, children's dishes • Six community gas grills and picnic area • Covered parking for 2 vehicles • Full-size washer and dryer • Smart/flat-screen TVs in living room and bedrooms • Free Wi-Fi • Standard coffee maker and Keurig • Walk to Gulf Place restaurants, shopping and entertainment • Convenient to Blue Mountain Beach, Dune Allen Beach, Grayton Beach, Seaside and other popular 30A communities Your 30A Beach Hideaway If you're searching for a 30A vacation rental near the beach, Beach Hideaway 30A offers the location, amenities and coastal atmosphere that make a Santa Rosa Beach vacation unforgettable. Located along Scenic Highway 30A in Santa Rosa Beach, Florida, this beautiful townhome is just a short walk from Spooky Lane Beach Access and the emerald-green waters of the Gulf of Mexico. Leave the car parked and spend your days walking to the beach, exploring nearby Gulf Place, relaxing beside one of two community pools or unwinding in the community hot tub. A convenient boardwalk along the community provides easy access to the neighborhood amenities and leads toward Spooky Lane Beach Access, located less than 300 yards from the townhome. Beach days are even easier with four backpack beach chairs, a beach umbrella and beach wagon provided for your stay. Load up the wagon and head out for a day on the sugar-white sand! Open-Concept Coastal Living Step inside Beach Hideaway 30A and enjoy a bright, welcoming interior designed for relaxed coastal living. The main living level features an open-concept kitchen, dining and living area filled with natural light. Comfortable seating provides plenty of room to gather after a day at the beach, while the queen sleeper sofa provides additional sleeping accommodations when needed. Open the doors to the private balcony and enjoy the coastal breeze and peek-a-boo Gulf views. With additional outdoor seating, it's a wonderful place to enjoy morning coffee, an afternoon drink or a quiet evening along 30A. A convenient half bathroom and full-size washer and dryer are also located on the main living level. Fully Stocked Kitchen Vacation meals are easy in the beautiful, fully stocked kitchen featuring quartz countertops, updated appliances and an open layout that keeps everyone connected. The kitchen is thoughtfully equipped with cookware, dishes, glassware, utensils and the essentials needed for preparing everything from quick beach-day breakfasts to family dinners. Spices are also provided, so you can pack less and enjoy more of your vacation. Coffee lovers have both a traditional coffee maker and Keurig available for those easy 30A mornings. The adjacent dining area provides seating for six, with additional seating available at the kitchen island and outside on the balcony. Primary King Suite with Private Balcony Upstairs, retreat to the spacious primary bedroom featuring a king bed, private ensuite bathroom and its own private balcony. Step outside in the morning with your coffee or relax at the end of the day while enjoying the coastal air and peek-a-boo views of the Gulf of Mexico. The private balcony gives the primary suite its own peaceful outdoor retreat. The ensuite bathroom features a spacious walk-in shower and provides privacy and convenience throughout your stay. Guest Suite Just down the hall, the second bedroom offers two full-size beds, making Beach Hideaway 30A a great option for families, couples traveling together or a 30A getaway with friends. This bedroom also features its own private full bathroom with a tub/shower combination. With sleeping accommodations spread between the two bedrooms and queen sleeper sofa, guests have flexibility when planning their Santa Rosa Beach vacation. Two Pools, Hot Tub, Tennis, and More Beach Hideaway 30A offers much more than a great location. Guests of The Legends of Santa Rosa Beach can enjoy an excellent collection of community amenities, including: • Two community swimming pools • Hot tub • Tennis court • Sand volleyball court • Six community gas grills • Picnic area • Community boardwalk • Covered parking Spend the morning at the beach, cool off in the pool during the afternoon, play a game of tennis or volleyball, and finish the evening relaxing in the hot tub. Walk to the Beach One of the best features of Beach Hideaway 30A is its convenient location near the Gulf of Mexico. Spooky Lane Beach Access is less than 300 yards away, making it easy to walk from the townhome to the beach. Guests can also reach the beach in just a couple of minutes by bicycle. With four backpack beach chairs, a beach umbrella and beach wagon included, getting your family and beach gear to the sand is simple. No need to spend your vacation searching for parking every time you want to visit the beach—grab your beach gear and go! Walk to Gulf Place on 30A Beach Hideaway 30A is also conveniently located near Gulf Place, one of Santa Rosa Beach's most popular areas for dining, shopping and entertainment. Walk or bike along 30A to explore local restaurants, coffee shops, boutiques, galleries and entertainment. Whether you're heading out for dinner, grabbing a morning coffee, shopping for something special or enjoying an evening along 30A, you'll love having so much nearby. The location also provides convenient access to Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, Seaside and the many restaurants, shops and coastal communities found throughout Scenic Highway 30A. Sleeping Arrangements Primary Bedroom King bed Private ensuite bathroom with walk-in shower Private balcony with peek-a-boo Gulf views Guest Bedroom Two full-size beds Private full bathroom with tub/shower combination Living Room Queen sleeper sofa Parking Covered parking is available beneath the townhome for two vehicles. Why Guests Love Beach Hideaway 30A Guests love Beach Hideaway 30A for its combination of location, beach access, amenities and beautifully renovated coastal interior. You can walk to the beach, walk to Gulf Place, relax beside two pools, soak in the hot tub and enjoy everything Scenic Highway 30A has to offer without sacrificing the comfort and space of a private townhome. Whether you're planning a family beach vacation, couples getaway, girls' trip or relaxing escape to Florida's Emerald Coast, Beach Hideaway 30A offers an ideal home base in Santa Rosa Beach. Spend your mornings sipping coffee on the private balcony, your days relaxing on the sugar-white beaches of the Gulf of Mexico and your evenings exploring the restaurants, shops and entertainment of Gulf Place and Scenic Highway 30A. Book Beach Hideaway 30A and experience a beautiful Santa Rosa Beach vacation rental near Gulf Place with walk-to-beach access, two community pools, a hot tub, beach gear, covered parking and everything you need for an unforgettable 30A vacation. Pack less. Vacation more.
